title: Fronted adjuncts and sentence adverbs
description: Before the subject: a fixed opener (in fact, at last, of course, …) with its comma, a prepositional phrase, a time word, an adverb before an imperative.

cases.sentence: in fact , he is a nice fellow .
cases.expect: 実は、彼は素敵なやつだ。

cases.sentence: at last , they came to a decision .
cases.expect: ついに、彼らは決定に達した。
ちょっとそこで私を待ってください。
